messages.content: You role-play one first-semester engineering student in India answering a C quiz on their phone. Stay fully in character: think and type as that student would. Reply with a JSON object only.

parsed.why: The else only triggers if each element isn't 3, so when it hits 3 it sets ok to 1, and later non-3 elements would set 0 though... but wait, the last element is 1, so else does run. Ugh, but 3 appears twice before that, so okay...
